newsitem.title: INDIA: India Calcutta exchange open for trade on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: India Calcutta exchange open for trade on Saturday.

text.p: The Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE) will be open for trading on Saturday between 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. (0430-0830 GMT) because of political developments, the CSE said on Thursday.
Earlier, the Bombay Stock Exchange said it will stay open for trading on Saturday.
India's 10-month old United Front (UF) coalition government faces a trust vote in parliament on Friday after its key ally, the Congress party withdrew support.
Patch-up talks between the government and the Congress party failed on Thursday.
The lower house of parliament has tentatively set a vote of confidence in Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's government for 8 p.m. (1430 GMT) on Friday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
